body.statement: Assume known conditional assignment probabilities, positive instrument and stratum support, conditional instrumental-variable randomization, the three declared consistency and exclusion conditions, no defiers, complier-conditional covariate-directional weak sample-selection monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\). For sampled-data transfer also impose multinomial interiority, convergence \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), and the model-specific centered local expansion. Form \(\mathcal F(p)\), compute each same-law coordinate endpoint, form the globally completed active tangent cells \(P_{v,b}^0\), and certify \(u_*\), \(\rho_0\), and \(r_0\). Apply CertGluePFL to \(\mathfrak G_0\) for the zero-offset benchmark and to the declared \(\mathfrak G_0(c_n)\) construction along moving-base sequences. Conditional on effective compatibility density, the transfer and repair theorems yield one simultaneous \(1-\eta_0\) honest semantic-label rule for every assertion in \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\), an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate Gaussian minimax certificate, and a vanishing sampled-data receipt. On compact local direction sets away from the active faces, the tangent labels equal the eventual lawful multinomial labels. No rectangular joint identified-set claim is made.
body.justification: This is the concrete causal deliverable linking the generic unbounded-fan decision theorem to always-selected-complier multiquantile inference.
body.gap: Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes report Job Corps average and multiple-quantile wage-effect bounds for the always-employed survivor target under assignment, while Chen and Flores incorporate noncompliance for average effects. Neither provides simultaneous semantic-label honesty for coordinatewise always-selected-complier quantile endpoints under covariate-directional selection or a replayable minimax certificate.
body.consumer: Program evaluators and replication archives obtain a reproducible multiquantile conclusion whose full-law fiber, fixed Gaussian fan, simultaneous label rule, and outward primal-dual ledger can be replayed without selecting favorable quantiles or active faces.

obligation.partial_result: The observed instrumental-variable contrasts, the finite response-type polytope, and the same-law endpoint witnesses close the causal identification part under the declared assumptions and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\geq m_*>0\).  They yield coordinatewise sharp effect endpoints and the honest outer inclusion for the joint effect vector.  The simultaneous semantic-label rule and sampled-data minimax interpretation still depend on effective incidence density, terminating global certification, and a globally honest unbounded-domain transfer.
